limitations: This reconciles the supplied proofread Part III with the existing website; it is not a new independent audit of every historical claim.
Sources already registered on the site are reused without changing their records. The midnight boundary in the 23 July study was checked against the published Soviet report: 24:00 on 22 July.
Original archival files and all cited print editions were not independently inspected. Access limits stated in the native notes are retained.
Historical map and timeline data is unchanged. Phase II has no separately stored passage-level Study Context; its summaries were checked against the revised studies.
